verdict.rationale: Kong's own GitHub README states that its plugins provide authentication and authorization for APIs using JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs and more, and its quickstart walks through adding authentication to an API. However, API keys and mTLS, two of the four named methods, are not explicitly documented in the evidence, and there are no plugin-level docs. missing for 10: explicit API-key (key-auth) and mTLS plugin evidence, in-depth auth plugin documentation, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can enforce authentication (API keys, OAuth2, JWT, mTLS) on upstream APIs via gateway plugins or policies

citations.quote: Authentication and authorization for APIs using methods like JWT, basic auth, OAuth, ACLs and more.
